H_12.governance_caveat: NO SINGLE ESTIMATE CAN BE LABELED 'THE TRUE EFFECTIVE SAMPLE SIZE'. Effective degrees of freedom is an asymptotic theoretical construct sensitive to kernel choice, lag truncation, and sign mapping. Crucially, overlapping-label dependence (induced mechanically by rolling horizons) must be distinguished from serial dependence in market returns (e.g. volatility clustering, GARCH effects, and macro trend persistence).

clean_feature_diagnostics.linear_redundancy_vs_correlation: Exact duplicates (e.g. rsi_14 vs rsi_14_norm, dist_ema_200 vs ema_slope_200 with |r|=1.000) represent mathematical identity redundancies that provide zero new information. Highly correlated features (e.g. 0.85 < |r| < 0.95) retain marginal independent variance but cause severe multicollinearity and coefficient variance inflation in unregularized linear models.

cost_architecture_audit.broker_spread_quote_convention: In spot gold, broker quote $0.20 is the full distance between Ask and Bid. A long trade buys at Ask and sells at Bid, crossing the spread exactly ONCE. Phase 17's terminology calling $0.20 a 'half-spread' and doubling to $0.40 was static terminology confusion.
cost_architecture_audit.overnight_swap_status: Positions in M5 models (H <= 96) were intraday (< 24h) and incurred no overnight financing. However, a daily or multi-day macro strategy WILL incur overnight swap financing debits (typically -0.015% to -0.03% daily debit for spot gold longs based on SOFR benchmark).

daily_bar_construction.h288_equivalence_refutation: H=288 M5 bars (24.0 hours) is NOT equivalent to one calendar day. Because gold markets close for 1 hour daily (Mon-Thu) and over weekends, an institutional trading day contains exactly 276 M5 bars. Rolling 288 bars shifts relative to settlement by 12 bars (1 hour) every day.

sample_size_and_complexity_constraint.overparameterization_warning: With only N=984 daily bars available across 2021-2024, attempting to use the existing 232 features results in N/D = 4.2:1, guaranteeing catastrophic overfitting. Any valid macro design must strictly enforce D <= 5 pre-specified explanatory variables.

pre_registered_research_specification.primary_hypothesis: Daily changes in US 10-Year Real Yields and US Dollar Index momentum forecast next-day spot gold excess returns net of execution spread and overnight financing swap debits.
pre_registered_research_specification.target: Next-day institutional settlement return: (Close_t+1 - Open_t+1) / Open_t+1
pre_registered_research_specification.holding_period: 1 institutional trading day (17:00 NY to 17:00 NY)
pre_registered_research_specification.execution_costs: Institutional spread $0.15-$0.20/oz + $0.05 slippage + overnight swap debit (-0.02%/day)
pre_registered_research_specification.promotion_gate: Net Profit Factor > 1.25 across non-overlapping out-of-sample walk-forward folds

final_verdict: MACRO RESEARCH FEASIBLE AFTER DATA ACQUISITION
verdict_rationale: The mathematical and statistical foundation for a daily macro research redesign is feasible: institutional daily bars (N=984 across 2021-2024) can be cleanly constructed from M5 data, and transaction friction drops from 26.6% (at H=24) to ~4.0%-6.0% of median daily moves ($10.06/oz). HOWEVER, zero macroeconomic variables (real yields, TIPS, DXY, inflation expectations) currently exist in the local repository. Research cannot proceed until external macroeconomic series are formally acquired according to the pre-registered Data Acquisition Specification. Model complexity must be strictly bounded to D <= 5 pre-specified drivers to avoid overparameterizing the 984 daily observations.
